LANDING.HEADLINE: Value bets and arbs from {books} bookmakers, priced against the sharp line
LANDING.HEADLINE_OFFLINE: Value bets and arbs, priced against the sharp line
LANDING.SUBHEADLINE: OpenEV removes Pinnacle's margin to get a fair price, flags every book that pays more, and writes each alert into a public record with the closing line next to it. Losses included.
LANDING.HERO_FOOTNOTE: 18+ only. Betting carries risk and no edge is guaranteed.
LANDING.INTRO: OpenEV reads {books} bookmakers and compares every price with Pinnacle, the sharpest market, after removing its margin. When a book pays more than the fair price you get a value bet; when two books disagree far enough you get an arb. Every alert lands in a public ledger and is checked against the closing line, so you can judge the method before you trust it.
LANDING.INTRO_OFFLINE: OpenEV compares bookmaker prices with Pinnacle, the sharpest market, after removing its margin. Every alert lands in a public ledger and is checked against the closing line. The live odds feed is not reachable right now, so the live numbers on this page are hidden until it is back.
LANDING.RESPONSIBLE: 18+ only. OpenEV shows prices and probabilities, not certainties: value bets lose often, and the long run can include long losing streaks. Only stake what you can afford to lose, and if gambling stops being fun, take a break and seek support.

DASH.TITLE: The product, live
DASH.BODY: Not a mockup: this frame is rendered from the live board. The best value bets right now, one market across every book, and how the fair price behind the top bet is built. Everything links through to the full pages.
DASH.FOOTNOTE: Live data from the OpenEV engine at the moment this page loaded. Prices move, so a bet can be gone by the time you open it.
DASH.ODDS_NOTE: Green prices beat the fair line. The outlined one is the bet in the next tab.
DASH.FAIR_NOTE: Pinnacle was last seen {sharpSeen}, {book} {bookSeen}. The safe edge uses the least favourable of the four methods.

FEATURES.TITLE: Built on three things
FEATURES.BODY: A price you can trust, accounts that stay open, and a record anyone can check.
FEATURES.DEVIG_TITLE: Four ways to remove the margin
FEATURES.DEVIG_BODY: Pinnacle's margin comes off with the power, multiplicative, additive and worst case methods. Next to the edge you see a safe edge that holds under all four.
FEATURES.EXCHANGE_BODY: Exchange and prediction market prices are read too, with commission and taker fees taken off before any edge is counted.
FEATURES.FRESH_BODY: Every bet shows how old both prices are and how much Pinnacle takes on the market. Thin or suspicious lines are labelled, not hidden.
FEATURES.HEALTH_BODY: The tracker reads your bets the way a trader would and flags what gets accounts limited: only value bets, odd stakes, thin markets.
FEATURES.ROUND_BODY: Kelly stakes are rounded to whole amounts. A stake like 23.47 is one of the quickest ways to look like a formula.
FEATURES.MIX_BODY: Log any bet, not only alerts, so the health check sees your whole account the way the bookmaker does.
FEATURES.LEDGER_BODY: Each alert is written down the moment it is found, with the price, the fair odds and the time. Nothing is edited or removed afterwards.
FEATURES.CLV_BODY: At kickoff each alert is compared with the closing fair price. Beating the close is the best early evidence that an edge was real.
FEATURES.LOSSES_BODY: Alerts that missed the close stay in the numbers. The record shows the share that beat it and the average, good weeks and bad.

TOOLS.ARBS_BODY: Both sides at different books when the prices cross, with the stake split for an equal return.

TOOLS.CALC_BODY: Remove the margin, size a Kelly stake, split an arb and convert odds by hand.
TOOLS.DISCORD_BODY: Value bets posted to your server as they appear. In development.

COVERAGE.REFERENCE_BODY: Pinnacle sets the fair price. Exchanges and prediction markets are priced after their fees.
COVERAGE.BOOKS_BODY: The books we look for mistakes at, sorted by how much they price.
COVERAGE.FOOTNOTE: {total} sources in total. More bookmakers are added as their feeds are verified.

PROOF.TITLE: The record
PROOF.BODY: Tips are easy to sell and hard to check. OpenEV keeps every alert it has ever raised and measures each one against the closing line, whether it looks good or not.
PROOF.DETAILS: How closing line value is measured
PROOF.DETAILS_BODY: Closing line value compares the odds you took with the fair odds just before the game started. Over many bets it tracks long run results far sooner than profit does.
PROOF.STEP_1: An alert is written down with the book's odds and the fair odds at that moment.
PROOF.STEP_2: Pinnacle's price keeps updating until the game starts.
PROOF.STEP_3: At kickoff the last fair price becomes the closing line.
PROOF.STEP_4: CLV is the alert odds divided by the closing fair odds, minus one. Positive means the bet beat the close.

STEPS.TITLE: How it works
STEPS.STEP_1_BODY: Pick the bookmakers you have accounts with and set your bankroll and Kelly fraction.
STEPS.STEP_2_BODY: Open a value bet, check the fair price and the confidence, then place the rounded stake at the book.
STEPS.STEP_3_BODY: Log it in the tracker. Closing line value and account health update as your games finish.

VALUE_BETS.LABEL: Positive EV
VALUE_BETS.HEADING: Value bets
VALUE_BETS.SUBHEADING: A bet shows up when a bookmaker pays more than the fair odds, which come from Pinnacle with its margin removed. Click a bet to see every book on that market, how the fair price was built and how the price moved.
VALUE_BETS.EMPTY: No value right now with these filters. Prices update every few seconds.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_FAIR: Fair odds use the power devig of Pinnacle. The safe EV uses the least favourable of four methods, so it is the cautious number.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_CONFIDENCE: Confidence follows Pinnacle's maximum stake on the market: the more money it accepts, the more the fair price can be trusted.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_STAKE: Stake is quarter Kelly on a bankroll of 1000. Sign in to use your own bankroll and Kelly fraction. A price not reconfirmed within five minutes drops off the board.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_STAKE_USER: Stake is {fraction} Kelly on your bankroll of {bankroll}, from your settings, after exchange commission. A price not reconfirmed within five minutes drops off the board.

BET.LABEL: Value bet
BET.GONE_TITLE: This price is no longer value
BET.GONE_BODY: The bookmaker moved, the fair line moved, or the game started. Value bets live only while the price beats the fair odds.
BET.TITLE: {bet} at {book}
BET.SUMMARY: {market} in {home} v {away}. {book} pays {odds} where the fair price is {fair}, a {chance} chance.
BET.DEVIG_TITLE: How the fair price is built
BET.METHOD_POWER_NOTE: Used for the headline EV. Takes more margin off long shots, as books do.
BET.METHOD_MULT_NOTE: Scales every outcome by the same factor.
BET.METHOD_ADD_NOTE: Removes the same amount from every outcome.
BET.METHOD_WORST_NOTE: The least favourable of the others for this bet. The safe EV.
BET.DEVIG_NOTE: Pinnacle prices this market with a {margin} margin and takes up to {stake} on it. Pinnacle was last seen {sharpSeen}, {book} {bookSeen}.
BET.ELSEWHERE_EMPTY: No other book prices this outcome.
BET.BEFORE_PRICE: Check the price at {book} is still {odds} or better.
BET.BEFORE_FAIR: Below {fair} the bet has no edge. Skip it.
BET.BEFORE_ROUND: Round the stake to a normal number. Odd amounts get accounts flagged.
BET.BEFORE_MIX: Mix in normal bets so the account does not look like it only takes value.
BET.FEE_COMMISSION: {book} keeps {commission} commission on net winnings, so every EV here uses the net odds of {net} instead of {odds}.
BET.FEE_TAKER: {book} charges a taker fee of {fee} times the price times one minus the price, so every EV here uses the net odds of {net} instead of {odds}.

ARBS.LABEL: Sure bets
ARBS.HEADING: Arbitrage
ARBS.SUBHEADING: Back every outcome at the book paying the most and the return is the same whatever happens. Stakes below split {total} so every outcome pays out the same. Arbs close fast: confirm every leg before placing the first one.
ARBS.EMPTY: No arbitrage right now. Soft books rarely disagree by enough at the same time; they show up most around team news and line moves.

PROOF.LABEL: Public record
PROOF.HEADING: Every alert, next to the closing line
PROOF.SUBHEADING: Each bet that crosses +2% EV is written down the moment it is found, with the price and the fair odds at that moment. Nothing is removed afterwards. At kickoff the last Pinnacle fair price becomes the closing line. Beating the close is the best evidence an edge was real, long before results settle it.

ACCOUNT.PROMPT_BODY: Track your bets, see your profit against the closing line and keep an eye on how bookmakers see your accounts.

HEALTH.WHY_BODY: Value betting only pays while your accounts stay open. Bookmakers limit accounts that look like they only bet when the price is wrong. This page reads your tracked bets the way a trader would and tells you, book by book, what stands out.
HEALTH.TIP_MIX: Mix in ordinary bets, such as popular games and accumulators.
HEALTH.TIP_ROUND: Stake round amounts like 10, 25 or 50, never 23.47.
HEALTH.TIP_SPREAD: Spread your bets over several bookmakers instead of hammering one.
HEALTH.TIP_TIMING: Avoid betting the second a line opens or on obscure markets only.
HEALTH.TIP_WITHDRAW: Withdraw now and then and keep the account looking like a normal punter's.
HEALTH.EMPTY: Track a few bets first. The check needs at least 5 bets at a bookmaker.
HEALTH.VALUE_SHARE_HINT: Share of bets tracked from a value bet or placed above the fair price
HEALTH.ROUND_SHARE_HINT: Share of stakes that are a whole multiple of 5
HEALTH.LOW_LIQUIDITY_HINT: Share of bets on markets where Pinnacle took less than 1,000
HEALTH.TOO_FEW: Fewer than 5 bets here, too early to judge.
HEALTH.ALL_CLEAR: Nothing stands out at this bookmaker.

WARN.ALL_VALUE_BETS: Almost every bet here is a value bet.
WARN.ALL_VALUE_BETS_FIX: Bookmakers profile accounts that only take mispriced lines. Place some ordinary bets on popular games too.
WARN.NEVER_ROUND_FIX: Amounts like 23.47 look like a staking formula. Round to 5 or 10.
WARN.LOW_LIQUIDITY: Most bets are on thin markets.
WARN.LOW_LIQUIDITY_FIX: Books watch winners closest on low limit markets. Favour bigger leagues and main markets.
WARN.BEATS_CLOSE: You beat the closing line on most bets.
WARN.BEATS_CLOSE_FIX: That is the main signal books limit on. Good for your edge, so protect the account with the other habits above.
